title: Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (cflt-prefixed): one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: body character 21 replaced by "_" (URL-safe Base64, outside the documented A-Z a-z 0-9 + /), with the checksum recomputed over the mutated body so only the alphabet property fails. Twin of "Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (cflt-prefixed): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
